Description: Breakfast is the first meal of the day usually eaten in the morning.
Lunch is a meal eaten around the middle of the day.
Dinner usually refers to what is in many Western cultures the biggest and most formal meal of the day.
Supper is used commonly as the term for the main evening meal  although its use varies considerably.
Food is any substance consumed by an organism for nutritional support.
Coffee is a beverage brewed from roasted  ground coffee beans.
Wine is an alcoholic drink made from fermented fruit.
When used in food  especially in granulated form  it is more formally called table salt. In the form of a natural crystalline mineral  salt is also known as rock salt or halite.
In nutrition  biology  and chemistry  fat usually means any ester of fatty acids  or a mixture of such compounds  most commonly those that occur in living beings or in food.
Sugar is the generic name for sweet-tasting  soluble carbohydrates  many of which are used in food.
In botany  a fruit is the seed-bearing structure in flowering plants (angiosperms) that is formed from the ovary after flowering
A meal is an occasion that takes place at a certain time and includes consumption of food.
A bottle is a narrow-necked container made of an impermeable material (such as glass  plastic or aluminium) in various shapes and sizes that stores and transports liquids.
Meat is animal tissue  often muscle  that is eaten as food.
Beer is an alcoholic beverage produced by the brewing and fermentation of starches from cereal grain—most commonly malted barley  although wheat  maize (corn)  rice  and oats are also used.
The Piperaceae (/ˌpɪpəˈreɪʃiː/)  also known as the pepper family  are a large family of flowering plants.
Vegetables are parts of plants that are consumed by humans or other animals as food.
A dish in gastronomy is a specific food preparation  a distinct article or variety of food ready to eat or to be served.
Cream is a dairy product composed of the higher-fat layer skimmed from the top of milk before homogenization.
A drink or beverage is a liquid intended for human consumption.
The gustatory system or sense of taste is the sensory system that is partially responsible for the perception of taste.
Milk is a white liquid food produced by the mammary glands of mammals.
Cheese is a type of dairy product produced in a range of flavors  textures  and forms by coagulation of the milk protein casein.
Bread is a staple food prepared from a dough of flour (usually wheat) and water  usually by baking.
Tea is an aromatic beverage prepared by pouring hot or boiling water over cured or fresh leaves of Camellia sinensis
Potatoes are underground tubers of the plant Solanum tuberosum  a perennial in the nightshade family Solanaceae.
In cooking  a sauce is a liquid  cream  or semi-solid food  served on or used in preparing other foods.
Juice is a drink made from the extraction or pressing of the natural liquid contained in fruit and vegetables.
A bean is the seed of any plant in the legume family (Fabaceae) used as a vegetable for human consumption or animal feed.
The tomato (US: /təmeɪtoʊ/  UK: /təmɑːtoʊ/)  Solanum lycopersicum  is a plant whose fruit is an edible berry that is eaten as a vegetable.
Butter is a dairy product made from the fat and protein components of churned cream.
A spoon (UK: /ˈspuːn/  US: /ˈspun/ SPOON) is a utensil consisting of a shallow bowl (also known as a head)  oval or round  at the end of a handle.

fork (from Latin: furca 'pitchfork') is a utensil  now usually made of metal  whose long handle terminates in a head that branches into several narrow and often slightly curved tines with which one can spear foods either to hold them to cut with a knife or to lift them to the mouth.
A knife (pl.: knives; from Old Norse knifr 'knife  dirk'[1]) is a tool or weapon with a cutting edge or blade  usually attached to a handle or hilt.
Cake is a flour confection made from flour  sugar  and other ingredients and is usually baked.
An onion (Allium cepa L.  from Latin cepa meaning onion)  also known as the bulb onion or common onion  is a vegetable that is the most widely cultivated species of the genus Allium.
Chocolate is a food made from roasted and ground cocoa beans that can be a liquid  solid  or paste  either on its own or as a flavoring in other foods.
An apple is a round  edible fruit produced by an apple tree (Malus spp.  among them the domestic or orchard apple; Malus domestica).
Rice is a cereal grain and in its domesticated form is the staple food of over half of the world's population  particularly in Asia and Africa.
A salad is a dish consisting of mixed ingredients  frequently vegetables.
Honey is a sweet and viscous substance made by several species of bees  the best-known of which are honey bees.
Garlic (Allium sativum) is a species of bulbous flowering plant in the genus Allium.
A cup is an open-top vessel (container) used to hold liquids for drinking  typically with a flattened hemispherical shape
A plate is a broad  mainly flat vessel on which food can be served.
